evidence_policy: Conservative: minimum measured absolute F-AHL16 solve saving per material, strengthened F-AHL17 build costs, and strengthened F-AHL18 cache-acquisition cost are all included.
finding: Self-build cost is material for a single very short column run but rapidly amortizes when representations are shared across columns or when trajectories contain hundreds to thousands of Richards solves.
design_implication: The target architecture should acquire one immutable cached representation at column/model initialization and retain that binding across the trajectory. Cache lookup must not occur in the constitutive inner loop.
next_action: Build an internal self-building cached research provider that removes the external table-file dependency and verify end-to-end equivalence with the selected F-AHL15/F-AHL16 representation.
nonclaims: No whole-SWAP wall-time claim is made.
The analysis uses controlled Richards solve savings, not full application runtime.
